notes.title: Hallways Post Release Update 1.0.5
notes.content:
[h2]Hallways 1.0.5 Update[/h2]

[h3]Bug Fixes:[/h3]
- Fixed clicking "Escape" in laptop on Underground Facility causing loss of mouse control
- Switched RHI rendering to DirectX 11, 65% performance boost and more stable (Reduces risk for crashes)

[h3]Balancing Fixes[/h3]
- Reduced difficulty on Bunker "Monday" level
- Clarified that flashlight does NOT deter "Whiskers," in tutorial, only the wall light does
- Added explanation for Siren in tutorial:
[list]
[*][i]When the Siren is going off you WILL NOT be able to hear Whiskers moving 
[*]Use laptop to disable Siren
[*]Siren goes off 4 separate times
[*]The fourth siren indicates the end of the night[/i]
[/list]

[h3]Updates
[/h3]
- Added a depth of field blur (Visual Improvement), adds to horror aspect
